source.source: Community-measured LiPo voltage-vs-SOC charts (intofpv.com LiPo voltage quick chart; usedbytes.com measured discharge profile). OCV curve per cell; sag from pack internal resistance handled separately.
source.notes: OCV-SOC shape is generic LiPo chemistry behavior, not a specific pack's datasheet. Capacity, mass and internal resistance (20 mOhm pack) are TYPICAL values for a 16 Ah 6S 25C-class pack: flagged estimated with wide uncertainty and must be replaced with the specific pack's datasheet/measurements for credible endurance numbers.
